title: [#18071] DTLS 1.3
description:
Initial work towards eventual support for DTLS 1.3 ([RFC 9147](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9147.html)). Incomplete; help wanted.

Supporting DTLS 1.3 poses two challenges:

1. Like with TLS 1.3, the `record_version` member of the header is no longer indicative of the version in use; instead, it is the same as for DTLS 1.2, and the handshake must be searched for a `supported_versions` extension which indicates the true version in use.
2. After the initial handshake, DTLS 1.3 records use a more compact header than is used for earlier DTLS versions. See [section 4 of the RFC](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9147.html#name-the-dtls-record-layer) for details.

In its current state, this draft MR gets and shows the correct DTLS version, dissects the compact header, and should handle DTLS ACK messages. It does not decrypt and dissect the body. Help wanted!

Closes #18071

notes.body: I'm not a (D)TLS expert by any stretch. I gratefully welcome other work on this.
@Lekensteyn
